messages.subject: Interactive GUI to install packages no longer works
parts:
Hi,

For some reason (unexplained), I can no longer use the button to 'Install packages'. Selecting this causes the program to display  utils:::menuInstallPkgs()  on the command line, but then not respond further. Other similar interactive GUI commands ('chooseCRANmirror()', 'setRepositories()') exhibit a similar behaviour: no response, I have to end the session and start a new one.

Can you suggest a solution?

Thanks,
Len
